profile.headline: Software Engineer at Johns Hopkins Community Physicians / Johns Hopkins Health System
profile.geoLocationName: Baltimore City County, Maryland, United States
profile.summary:
Skilled and dedicated healthcare administration professional with 15+ years of exceptional decision support data analytics. Adept at developing and designing meaningful databases and dashboards for monitoring operational, financial, quality, productivity and/or clinical performance. Proficient at establishing and managing production data and analytics processes and deliverables. 

Highly focused and results-oriented in supporting deadline-driven operations; able to engage effectively with all levels of an organization and demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Access, Excel, Powerpoint, Outlook), MS SQL, and Epic Data Model – Resolute Professional Billing; competent in Confluence, Cognos Business Intelligence 10/11, and SAP; working knowledge of All Scripts, and Tableau.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided subject matter expertise for various departments on data analyses that impacted entity-wide operational decisions.  Performed complex data analyses related to risk mitigation, business planning, and performance improvement. Configured, analyzed, and maintained the primary SQL database used by the Finance department. Developed analytical tools for the financial analysts to better manage their practice regions. Responsible for clinical and financial report deliverables from all levels of the organization. 

Key Contributions:
•	Documented all personally responsible Epic report products (60+ month-close reports) and processes and successfully cross-trained another staff member in my duties.
•	Developed a datasource of summarized Epic billing transaction (14M+ records and counting) for Finance to query against for its business/strategic planning endeavors. 
•	Key facilitator for Finance moving to EPSi budgeting software from its old manual, Excel file workflows.
•	Implemented highly complex changes related to performance improvement to the profit & loss financial statements.

company.name: Information Systems (IT), Johns Hopkins Community Physicians / Johns Hopkins Health System

positions.title: Senior Financial Reporting Analyst
positions.description:
•	Effectively managed Finance’s transition in Dec 2015 from using IDX billing data to Epic billing data so month-close processes were not impacted. 
•	Produced monthly profit & loss financial statements (200+ files) for month close.
•	Maintained security access on SharePoint documents library containing financial statements servicing 150+ employees.
•	Managed multiple ad hoc data requests / data analyses on billing data.
•	Migrated 10 years of fiscal data to SQL server platform, allowing better turnaround on trend analysis.
•	Developed tool that consumed data from SAP, generating profit & loss financial statements on a monthly basis.
•	Created databases to track data, positively impacting business processes of several external departments (Risk, Credentialing, Medical Affairs, and Education).

company.name: Finance, Johns Hopkins Community Physicians / Johns Hopkins Health System

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description:
•	Administering/developing MS Access database applications and migrating MS Access databases to SQL Server.
•	Provide database support to the Integration Services Team and Hopkins community at large.
•	Participated in Directory Services development efforts.
•	Migrated old FoxPro Tuition Grant database to MS Access/SQL Server 2005 solution.
•	Transition from Oracle to SQL Server for the JHED directory system. 
•	Troubleshooting MS Access database issues for external customers.
